attchmntText: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited has inform the Exchange that a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company held on March 23, 2016, it was decided that the Company will not pursue the Payments bank opportunity and hence would surrender the in-principle approval accorded by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to its wholly owned subsidiary "Cholamandalam Distribution Services Limited" (CDSL) to establish a payments bank in the private sector. attchmntText: Cholamandalam Investments And Finance Ltd had informed the Exchange regarding the approval of the company's BODs of an issue of up to 30,00,000 equity shares of Rs.10/- each to M/s.DBS Bank Ltd., Singapore(DBS) at a price of Rs.150/-(including a premium of Rs.140/-) per share on a preferential basis(the Preferential Issue).The issue of shares to DBS was subject, among other things, to the necessary shareholders' and regulatory approvals. The proposed preferential issue formed part of an overall transaction involving an agreement by DBS to purchase from M/s Tube Investments of India Ltd.(TI)(the principal shareholder of the company) up to 25% of the paid up equity capital of the company. The overall transaction triggered an open offer by DBS, under the SEBI(Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers)Regulations,1997(the Takeover Regulations). The company has now informed that, the company will not be making the preferential issue to DBS. However, the existing promoters of the company(i.e. TI and its affiliates)and DBS will proceed with the amended transaction, which will now comprise an open offer by DBS of up to 20% of the existing paid-up share capital of the company and the purchase by DBS, following completion of the open offer, from the existing promoters of the company, of between 15.1% and 27.5% of the paid-up share capital of the company. As before, DBS and the existing promoters of the company will hold an equal number of shares in the company following completion of the transaction.

attchmntText: Cholamandalam Investments And Finance Ltd has informed the Exchange that the BODs at their meeting held on June 16,2005 has approved an issue of up to 30,00,000 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each to M/s DBS Bank Ltd., Singapore (DBS) at a premium of Rs.140/- per share on a preferential Basis. The issue of shares to DBS shall be subject to the approval of shareholders of the Company pursuant to section 81(1A) of the Companies Act,1956,the Guidelines for Preferential Issues contained in the SEBI (Disclosures and Investors Protection)Guidelines,2000 and such statutory and other approvals  as may be required in this regard. An EGM of the shareholders of the Company is being convened on July 16, 2005 to take their approval for the above preferential issue. The company has further informed that the board took note of the proposal by M/s. Tube Investments of India Ltd., the principal shareholder of the Company, to sell up to 94,86,619 equity shares of the Company representing 25% of the paid up equity capital of the Company, in favour of the DBS at price not less than Rs.150/- per share. The board further noted that above acquisition of shares by DBS triggers an open offer, under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of shares and Takeovers) Regulations.

attchmntText: Cholamandalam Investments And Finance Ltd has informed the Exchange that the BOD's in their meeting held on April 27, 2005, have recommended a dividend of 50%. The Company has further informed that the AGM of the Company will be held on July 26, 2005 and the Book Closure dates are from July 20, 2005 to July 26, 2005 (both days inclusive).

attchmntText: Cholamandalam Investments And Finance Ltd has informed the Exchange that the BODs of the Company at its meeting held on March 22, 2005 has approved issue of the following non convertible debentures on a private placement basis in one or more series to Mutual Funds/Institutions/Banks/Bodies Corporate or other agencies: 1) medium term Non-Convertible Debentures up to an amount of Rs. 400 crs. and 2) short term Non-Convertible Debentures up to an amount of Rs. 250 crs. of debentures outstanding at any point in time.

attchmntText: Cholamandalam Investments And Finance Ltd has informed the Exchange that M/s. Cholamandalam Risk Services Limited (CRSL, formerly known as Cholamandalam AXA Risk Services Ltd) has ceased to be the subsidiary of the company w.e.f. October 28, 2004. This is consequent to the purchase of 5,00,000 equity shares of M/s Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Company Ltd (MS) on private placement basis by CRSL pursuant to a joint venture entered into with MS.

attchmntText: Cholamandalam Investments And Finance Ltd has informed the Exchange that the Company propose to mobilise Rs.200 Crores through the private placement of debentures, in one or more tranches during the FY 2004-05.

attchmntText: Clarification of News : The press had reports that Cholamandalam Investments And Finance Limited is exploring options for converting the company into a full-fledged bank. The Exchange, in order to verify the accuracy or otherwise of the information reported in the press and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the officials of the company. Cholamandalam Investments And Finance Limited has vide its letter inter-alia stated, "We wish to inform you that the Company presently does not have any specific proposal to convert the Company into a full fledged bank."
